Definition: Count of distinct users registered in the selected period.
Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) where registration_datetime in period
Interpretation: Count of new user IDs created in the period.
Limitation: Snapshot dataset supports lifetime count and registration-date grouping; no event stream.

Definition: Distinct users registered on or before the selected date.
Interpretation: Non-decreasing total, subject to identity merges/deletions.
Limitation: Simulated dataset only; not production.

Definition: Users marked active in the supplied 7-day activity flag.
Business Purpose: Provide a supplied snapshot activity indicator.
Limitation: Flag logic and as-of timestamp are not fully documented.

Definition: Users marked active in the supplied 30-day activity flag.
Business Purpose: Provide a supplied snapshot activity indicator.
Limitation: Flag logic and as-of timestamp require definition.

Definition: Users whose account_status is Inactive.
Limitation: Account status is not equivalent to behavioural inactivity.

Definition: Users whose account_status is Suspended.
Limitation: No suspension reason or history provided.

Definition: Share of users with verified email status.
Formula: verified users / users with non-null verification status
Limitation: Cross-sectional status, not cohort conversion over time.

Definition: Share of users whose onboarding status is completed.
Formula: completed users / users with known onboarding status
Limitation: No onboarding start/completion timestamps or step-level funnel.

Definition: Share of users marked opted in among users with a known preference.
Limitation: Consent purpose, version and timestamp are not modelled.

Definition: Share of users with consent_status accepted.
Limitation: Consent scope/version/timestamp not provided.

Definition: New users grouped by acquisition_source.
Interpretation: Source counts are descriptive, not channel ROI.
Limitation: No spend/campaign attribution data.

Definition: Registrations where acquisition_source is Referral.
Limitation: Registration attribution does not prove activation or conversion.

Definition: New users grouped by primary_device.
Limitation: Primary device may not represent all sessions.

Definition: New users grouped by platform.
Interpretation: All 1,000 rows are Web in supplied simulated dataset.
Limitation: No platform event history; column absent from supplied dictionary tab.

Definition: Users with at least two distinct qualifying sessions in a period.
Interpretation: Not calculable from snapshot users table.
Limitation: No session-level records or session_id.

Definition: Unique users with a qualifying activity event on a calendar day.
Interpretation: Not calculable from snapshot flags alone.
Limitation: Requires timestamped qualifying event taxonomy.

Definition: Unique users with a qualifying activity event in calendar month.
Interpretation: Not calculable from snapshot flags alone.
Limitation: Requires event-level activity.

Definition: Average DAU divided by MAU for the same period.
Limitation: Requires consistent event definition and daily events.

Definition: Share of eligible users who use a feature at least once in a period.
Limitation: No feature event log or eligibility denominator.

Definition: Count of unique task-start events.
Limitation: No task activity/event dataset in approved Task 01 workbook.

Definition: Count of task completions that pass validation.
Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT task_activity_id) where status='completed' and validation_status='passed'
Limitation: No task activity dataset.

Definition: Validated completed task activities divided by started task activities.
Limitation: Requires task start and validated completion records.

Definition: Failed task attempts divided by all started task attempts.
Limitation: No failure events or failure taxonomy.

Definition: Count of successfully posted reward-credit transactions.
Limitation: No reward ledger in Task 01 dataset.

Definition: Sum of credited reward amounts grouped by reward unit.
Formula: SUM(amount) where status='credited' GROUP BY unit
Limitation: No reward amounts or units supplied.

Definition: Count of reward transactions reversed after posting.
Limitation: No reward ledger or reversal relationship.

Definition: Sum of reward amounts currently pending validation/posting.
Limitation: No reward ledger; accounting treatment requires finance approval.

Definition: Count of unique wallet transactions created in period.
Limitation: No wallet transaction records.

Definition: Sum of completed credit transactions by unit.
Limitation: No wallet records; unit and accounting rules need confirmation.

Definition: Count of completed transactions subsequently reversed.
Limitation: No wallet ledger or reversal link.

Definition: Count of successful redemption/debit transactions.
Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) where type='redemption' and status='completed'
Limitation: No wallet records; transaction taxonomy proposed.

Definition: Count of unique withdrawal requests created in period.
Limitation: No withdrawal dataset.

Definition: Completed withdrawals divided by finalised requests.
Business Purpose: Measure outcome rate for finalised requests.
Limitation: Pending requests excluded; final-state rules require confirmation.

Definition: Count and value of withdrawals currently pending/processing.
Formula: COUNT(*) and SUM(requested_amount) where status in pending states
Limitation: No withdrawal records or approved status taxonomy.

Definition: Average elapsed time from request to final outcome.
Limitation: No lifecycle timestamps; exclude still-open requests from completed-time average.

Definition: Rejected withdrawals divided by finalised requests.
Limitation: No withdrawal records or rejection reason taxonomy.

Definition: Count of unique referral invitations/codes created.
Interpretation: Not calculable as invitation events; user table has referral code only.
Limitation: Referral code presence is not a referral-created event.

Definition: Referred users who registered and are attributed to a referrer.
Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT referred_user_id) with valid referrer link
Interpretation: 119 referral-source registrations only; no referrer-to-referred linkage.
Limitation: Attribution detail not sufficient for referral conversion.

Definition: Referred registrations that meet defined activation criteria divided by referred registrations.
Limitation: No referral relationship or activation event.

Definition: Successful referral conversions divided by eligible referral registrations.
Limitation: Registration alone cannot be treated as conversion.

Definition: Count of support tickets created in period.
Limitation: No support-ticket data.

Definition: Unique users viewing help content in period.
Limitation: No help-centre event/content data.
